texts.Route107_Text_DarrinIntro: Yawn…\pI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.$
texts.Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated: Ahaha, I lost…\nI'll take a snooze, I think…$
texts.Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle: Floating and being rocked by\nthe waves--it's like sleeping in\la plush, comfy bed.$

texts.Route107_Text_TonyIntro: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!$
texts.Route107_Text_TonyDefeated: I lost on my home field…\nI'm in shock!$
texts.Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams…\pIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.$

texts.Route107_Text_DeniseIntro: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?$
texts.Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.$

texts.Route107_Text_BethIntro: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!$
texts.Route107_Text_BethDefeated: I wasn't good enough for you.$
texts.Route107_Text_BethPostBattle: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!$

texts.Route107_Text_LisaIntro: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!$
texts.Route107_Text_LisaDefeated: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.$
texts.Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.$
texts.Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?$

texts.Route107_Text_RayIntro: RAY: We always battle POKéMON,\nme and my sister.\pI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!$
texts.Route107_Text_RayDefeated: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!$
texts.Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon: RAY: If you want to battle us,\ngo bring some more POKéMON!$
texts.Route107_Text_RayPostBattle: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\lpartner!$

texts.Route107_Text_CamronIntro: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm nowhere near tired!$
texts.Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle: I still have swimming and running left\nto do after this.\pAm I going to be okay?$
